claim: A Nature Communications cross-trait GWAS study reported that the genetic correlation between multiple sclerosis and ulcerative colitis was greater than the genetic correlation between multiple sclerosis and Crohn disease in the datasets it analyzed.
future_grounding_route: The project has an independent grounded MS-UC genetic-correlation backdrop; any future refresh should re-download the exact external summary statistics or supplementary tables with hashes before treating this external literature claim as rerunnable.
